description: Bright 52m² apartment, renovated in 2023, in the heart of Paris (Louvre-Opéra-Bourse). Located on the 3rd floor of a historic 1930s building, protected, with an elevator (7 persons). Ideal for 5 people, south-facing, double glazing, and ventiltors for each room (available from June 1 to October 1). Perfectly located to explore Paris on foot: Passage des Panoramas, Musée Grévin, Opera, Louvre, Montmartre. Pedestrian street. Paris City Hall authorization: DP 075 102 19 V 0181.The spaceNewly refurbished apartment featuring high ceilings, historical hardwood floors, and premium appliances. Fully equipped for comfort, it offers two bedrooms (one with a queen bed, the other with twin beds), a living area with a high-quality Poltrone Sofa bed, and an open-concept kitchen. Includes separate toilet, central air conditioning from 1st june to 1st october, Wi-Fi, and two TVs. Enjoy keyless entry with a stay-specific code. Professional cleaning services ensure prepared beds and available towels upon your arrival. Ideal for families or groups of friends.Guest access100%Other things to noteFor check-in and check-out, we've implemented an extremely convenient smart lock system. Building access is secured with a code and surveillance cameras in common areas, ensuring peace and security. Moreover, the building features several spacious elevators, making your apartment access handy and comfortable. Check-in starts at 3:00 PM: You're free to arrive at any time after 3:00 PM. Following your booking, we'll provide a personal access code valid throughout your stay, allowing self-entry at your convenience.
